_why: merge-candidates.py will not invent a region for a base it does not know. These three bases are new to _data/listings/iowa.json and each needs one entry added to the file's region_of object before the merge will append the record. Without it the merge reports 'no region for its base' and skips the record rather than filing it somewhere plausible.
_apply: Add each base to region_of in _data/listings/iowa.json, keeping the existing key names (north-ia, west-ia). Then: python3 scripts/merge-candidates.py _todo/LETTA-DEPTH-20261025/iowa-verified.json --state iowa

_region_labels_for_context.west-ia: Council Bluffs, Sioux City and the west

_note_on_labels: Westside is Crawford County, in the west-central cluster the coverage instrument names as Iowa's largest hole, so west-ia is right rather than a new region. Mallard (Palo Alto County) and Nora Springs (Floyd County) are both north Iowa; if the reviewer judges Floyd County closer to the Cedar Rapids east region, that is an editorial call and the label is the only thing that changes.
